headline: Japanese borrowing costs hit 30-year high as Bessent says Tokyo may intervene to boost yen
detail: Higher borrowing costs globally can pressure tech valuations by increasing the cost of capital and reducing future earnings' present value. Yen intervention adds currency volatility.
rec: No direct trade, but keep an eye on broader market sentiment and rate-sensitive tech names.

rec: No direct trade, but monitor for broader inflationary pressures and market risk-off sentiment.
